title: Healthcare Professional Licensing & Retention
description: The mandatory licensing pathway for medical doctors, dentists, pharmacists, nurses, and allied health professionals to register with statutory regulatory councils and renew annual practice retention licences.

consultant.name: Babanawo Consults
consultant.specialty: Ghana Healthcare Regulatory & Clinical Practice Advisory

steps.title: Medical & Dental Council (MDC) Practitioner Licensing
steps.why: Under Part II of the Health Professions Regulatory Bodies Act 2013 (Act 857), medical doctors and dental surgeons must obtain provisional and full registration to practice in Ghana.
steps.do_this_when: Following medical school housemanship or when foreign doctors seek Ghana certification.

options.label: Medical and Dental Council Registration Requirements
options.notes: Official requirements guidelines for provisional and permanent registration.

options.label: MDC Annual Practice Licence Retention Form
options.notes: Annual practising licence retention for medical practitioners.

steps.title: Pharmacy Council Pharmacist & Premises Licensing
steps.why: Pharmacists, over-the-counter medicine practitioners, and wholesale premises must hold statutory registration and annual premises licences.
steps.do_this_when: Upon completing pharmacy internship or opening community/wholesale pharmacy facilities.

options.label: Pharmacy Council Downloads & Premises Registration
options.notes: Downloads for practitioner registration and online pharmacy premises renewals.

steps.title: Allied Health Professions Council (AHPC) Registration
steps.why: Medical laboratory scientists, physiotherapists, radiographers, and dietitians must be certified under Act 857.
steps.do_this_when: Following graduation and completion of mandatory internship.

options.label: Allied Health Professions Council Services & Licensing
options.notes: Registration and annual PIN renewal for allied health professionals.

steps.title: Nursing & Midwifery Council Licensure Examination & PIN
steps.why: Candidates must pass the NMC professional licensing examination to receive a professional PIN to practice clinically in health facilities.
steps.do_this_when: Following completion of nursing diploma or degree.

options.label: NMC Annual PIN Renewal Portal
options.notes: Annual nurse and midwife practising PIN renewal.
